decisions.what: Inserted new <footer id='contact' class='bg-gray-900 text-white py-16'> between </main> and the existing site footer
decisions.why: Spec required a footer element with id='contact' (nav anchor target) with a 3-column grid: brand name/tagline, social media links (Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest inline SVGs 24x24), and contact email (contact@luxurybrand.com mailto). An existing footer without that id was already present, so the new section was inserted above it to satisfy the anchor link and the distinct bg-gray-900 styling specified.

decisions.what: Used <nav aria-label='Social media links'> wrapping the social icon links
decisions.why: Spec says 'use semantic HTML (nav for social links if appropriate)' and includes aria-labels on each anchor
